static_traits.name: He Ning
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to talk with (average topics), friendship generally not yet visibly affected; but has not yet talked with friends about game-related doubts and failure
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar issues; never received psychotherapy or treatment for psychological issues; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Calm tone, fairly cooperative; able to clearly describe automatic thoughts and feelings; slightly anxious with self-doubt; clear logic

basic_info.main_problem: Develops a sense of failure and doubts about ability regarding video game (especially Fortnite) related goals, lasting several months and leading to avoidance of games.
basic_info.core_demands: These doubts and feelings of failure affect my enjoyment of video games and my overall confidence, and I hope to improve through counseling.
growth_experiences: In the past few months, playing Fortnite with friends, the friends gradually became very good, while He Ning himself found it hard to keep up with the pace; under the comparison, stress and self-doubt arose, and he consequently linked the feelings of failure and fear with the game, and finally began completely avoiding Fortnite, with leisure and entertainment affected.

special_situations.event: When thinking about playing Fortnite or facing match-start preparation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot clear the level, it proves I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Completely avoids games, stops trying to avoid feelings of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may never be able to complete Fortnite

special_situations.event: Hearing friends discuss Fortnite or seeing friends perform well in the game
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not as good as my friends, I am not worthy of acceptance
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids playing Fortnite with friends, reducing interaction in games
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them

special_situations.event: When setting and trying small goals in games
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot even complete small goals, it means I am terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Quitting early, stopping practice, negating any progress
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Even small goals I cannot achieve; doing a little does not count either

special_situations.event: When thinking others might judge my gaming level
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I perform poorly, others will look down on me or think I am making a fuss over nothing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not expressing true feelings to friends, avoiding situations of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will think I am terrible

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted by peers, seen as capable, and to fit into the group
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as incompetent, appearing 'melodramatic', thus being excluded or looked down upon
defense_goal: Avoiding games to avoid failure and shame
Concealing vulnerability, not expressing to friends, to maintain safety and self-esteem

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough failure, easily compared with others
object_relations.object_representation: A peer group that judges oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about how friends might view oneself (e.g., whether they would think one is making a fuss or is terrible)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to project inner worries of being rejected onto others, believing friends will judge oneself negatively (transference)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a gentle, validating tone; first empathizing with their worries, then inviting them to examine evidence and other possible interpretations; avoiding blame and arbitrariness, using open-ended questions to guide concretization of worries and facts.

manifestations: Worrying that the skill gap with friends will cause non-acceptance or being looked down upon
Avoids group games to evade evaluation
Not expressing true feelings to friends to avoid vulnerable exposure
outcomes: Decreased enjoyment of leisure and games

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains behavioral impulses toward others or the environment, gives up seeking others to do things for them, and instead does it to the self, turning originally outward energy against the self.
manifestations: Not expressing one's doubts and sense of failure to friends
Turns stress and criticism toward oneself (self-reproach)
Preferring to avoid playing together rather than seek external support

contact_model.definition: Has poor self-reflection and excessive self-restriction, harsh self-reproach, overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Worrying about appearing 'melodramatic' or 'weak', thus suppressing expression
Overly concerned about others' possible views, cautiously restrains one's own behavior
Reducing help-seeking on the grounds of 'I am not worthy/should not trouble others'

positive_force: Possessing the social resource of potential friend support (anticipating friends may be supportive)
Willing to try reality testing and behavioral experiments, openly explores thinking
Able to identify automatic thoughts and willing to take small steps (brief play)
negative_force: Frequent comparison with peers' levels leads to self-deprecation
Catastrophic predictions and jumping to conclusions (believing one can never complete)
Avoidance behavior maintaining feelings of failure and fear
Overly concerned about others' evaluations, seeks external validation to determine self-worth

antecedent: Thinking about starting to play Fortnite
Sees friends perform excellently in games or progress quickly
target_behavior.core_reason: Comparing with peers producing self-doubt and shame, fearing failure and being judged, forming negative automatic thoughts ('I may never complete it')
target_behavior.function: Escapes feelings of failure and shame, avoids others' negative evaluations and self-devaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased enjoyment of leisure and games, overall damaged confidence, maintained anxiety and self-doubt
